_contract: A PROPOSAL for the Phase-C2 behavioural selection. It AUTHORIZES NOTHING and FUNDS NOTHING: there is no grant, no readiness record, no authorization, no bundle and no provider resource. It exists so a review can see the exact inputs, the exact protocol, the derived storage and the derived money before any of those are created.

protocol_binding._read_not_restated: the schedule, seeds, batteries, anchor, ranking rule and tie-break are READ from the frozen protocol. A second copy is how two documents come to disagree about an experiment that has not run.

screening.ranking_rule: maximize the paired single-seed delta correct_overall(candidate - B) on the screening battery. B is the anchor, never an advancing candidate. usable_rollout is NOT positive ranking credit.
screening.tie_break: the already-frozen full-search ordering, then the deterministic state id. Both are fixed before any behavioural datum exists.
screening.decides: which 1 candidate(s) advance. Ranking only — no veto is evaluated here and no promotion can be claimed from it.
screening._no_verdict_here: screening may not produce GO/NO_GO/INCONCLUSIVE and may not promote

confirmation.decides: the C2 incumbent, under the frozen Phase-C decision rule. This is the only evidence that may name one.

protocol_binding.no_canonical_control: the project's original initialization is NOT carried forward as a C2 arm. It answers no additional C2 question: a candidate that beats the old control but loses to B must not promote, and one that bea

candidate_inputs._joined_not_transcribed: each entry is attempt 3's frozen selection JOINED to the destination-verified durable product the replay reconstructed. The join IS the check: a product whose identity differs from what the selection commits is refused, so this session cannot be pointed at a checkpoint nobody reconstructed.

anchor_b.role: frozen_c1_treatment_b -- the behavioural incumbent and the only anchor
anchor_b._is_not_a_staged_durable_input: baseline-completion attempt 8 rebuilt B exactly and its artifact manifest preserved evidence and logs, not checkpoint bytes. The identity survived; the weights did not.
anchor_b.gate: the materialized B must match every field of required_identity. If it does not, NO SCREENING PROBE MAY START: an anchor that is not the frozen incumbent makes every delta meaningless.
anchor_b._not_a_thirteenth_probe: preparing B is initialization. The protocol is twelve probes and remains twelve; B's construction produces the arm six of them are measured against.

components_gib._b_materialization_transient_is: B is NOT a staged durable input -- baseline-completion attempt 8 preserved its evidence and not its bytes -- so this session rebuilds it from the frozen C1 treatment path before any probe. A four-step construction holds its predecessors while it builds; this is the worst single path's intermediates as measured during the replay. It is transient and released once B is verified
components_gib._staged_initializations_is: 6 screening arms -- the five reconstructed candidates and the incumbent B, each staged before any probe runs
components_gib._working_set_is: 596,049,920 parameters as bf16 weights plus an fp32 gradient and AdamW's two fp32 moments. Probes run sequentially, so exactly one of these is resident at a time

storage._units: the residency is derived in GiB and the provider's flag is GB. The conversion is the one recorded in configs/infrastructure/provider_storage_pricing.json, not a local convention: rounding a GiB subtotal straight into a GB flag under-provisions by 7%.
storage._why_not_400: the full search's 400 GB was derived for a beam that generates a whole level before pruning and holds sixty compressed states at the level boundary. This session holds one training working set at a time and retains twelve small checkpoints; carrying 400 GB here would bill for storage nothing uses.
storage._why_it_rounds_up: a volume that fills mid-probe loses the probe. The margin is 25% over a component sum that is itself derived from measured artifact sizes.

money._gpu_rate_is_live: re-quoted from gpuTypes.securePrice; the authorization must re-quote again at issue
money.probe_minutes_basis: logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/runs/attempt18/evidence/c1_evidence.json stages F/G/H, with per-probe PROBE_TRAINED/PROBE_SCORED markers from logs/stages/stage-1/phase_c1/runs/attempt18/evidence/driver_run.log
money._b_preparation_is_initialization: added to the session's runtime, not to the probe count. The protocol is twelve probes and stays twelve; the pod is alive longer because the sixth arm has to be built before any of them can measure against it.
money._ceiling_includes: both named reserves, a 10% contingency and a 30-minute artifact recovery reserve
money._two_numbers: the GPU rate is re-quotable from the provider and the storage price is not, so they are derived apart and summed. A live GPU quote is not evidence that separately priced storage is free.

_historical_planning_reference._what_changed: the GPU minutes are unchanged -- they come from the same six measured probes. The all-in ceiling is LOWER because the storage provision is derived from this session's own topology (90 GB) instead of carrying the full search's 400 GB, which was sized for a beam holding sixty compressed states at a level boundary.

explicitly_not_proposed: any re-ranking of the 14 complete leaves
any B remeasurement outside the 12-probe protocol
the original canonical control as a C2 arm

implementation_state.schedule_control_flow: scripts/experiments/phase_c2/behavioural_schedule.py — BUILT and rehearsed end to end: 26 tests covering descriptors, ranking, the frozen tie-break, advancement, the completeness gate and every case the protocol forbids
implementation_state.driver: scripts/pod/autoinit_c2_behavioural_driver.py — BUILT. Stages P/S/R/C/D rehearsed screening -> advancement -> confirmation on the real candidates, the real frozen seeds and the real batteries, with only those two seams replaced.
implementation_state.b_binding: BUILT; construction hash matches C1's frozen 3a233a9017b3…
implementation_state.storage_derivation: BUILT; 120 GB, GiB->GB through the repository's recorded conversion
implementation_state.money_derivation: BUILT; live quote, GPU and storage apart, B's preparation included

incumbent_b.role: frozen_c1_treatment_b -- the behavioural incumbent and the only anchor

construction._bound_not_redeclared: the steps come from C1's own constructor and the spec hash is checked against the value C1's preregistration froze. A second declaration of this path is how two constructions of one thing come to differ.

required_identity._observed_not_preregistered: these come from c1_arm_identities.json, which recorded what attempt 18 actually built. `treatment_output_digest_was_pre_pinned` is False there, because that attempt was the operator's first execution. It is the strongest available content identity of B, and this says which it is.

availability._why_it_is_not_staged: baseline-completion attempt 8 rebuilt B exactly and its artifact manifest preserved evidence and logs, not checkpoint bytes. The identity survived; the weights did not.

incumbent_b.gate: the materialized B must match every field of required_identity. If it does not, NO SCREENING PROBE MAY START: an anchor that is not the frozen incumbent makes every delta meaningless.
incumbent_b._not_a_thirteenth_probe: preparing B is initialization. The protocol is twelve probes and remains twelve; B's construction produces the arm six of them are measured against.

incumbent_b_preparation._basis: the worst observation of each implementation anywhere in attempt 3's telemetry, the same bound the replay spent against and which reproduced all five paths

execution_sequence: P  verify the five durable candidates; materialize B from the frozen C1 treatment path and gate on its exact identity. If that gate fails, no screening probe starts.
S  six fresh screening probes -- five candidates and B on the one frozen screening seed -- each persisted as it completes.
R  score c2_screening_v1, rank by paired delta against B, advance EXACTLY one by the frozen tie-break. No verdict may leave this stage.
C  six fresh confirmation probes -- the advanced candidate and B, paired across the three frozen seeds. Cannot begin until every screening probe is trained AND scored.
D  score c1_confirmation_v1 and apply C1's frozen decision rule. The only stage that may name a C2 incumbent. Then STOP.
